observations: body L1-L8: the steps are right: with sines and cosines to the radius R, sin² (x/2) = (R² − R cos x)/2 (as on p. 202), so that crd² x = 2R² − 2R cos x; the same for 60° and β turns L3 into L5, and dividing by 2R gives L7 and L8, cos x = R cos 60° : cos β, which is the rule of the right spherical triangle found on p. 307. The minus signs are printed as dashes (9.5 to 10.3 pt) and set as minus signs.

body L9-L14: «Al–Battānī» (L11) is letter-spaced, with a long dash (5.3 pt); the dash before «Similiter» (L14) measures 9.6 pt. With R = 60p and cos 60° = 30p, R cos 60° = 1800; divided by the cosine of the latitude it gives the cosine of x, and the arc found from it as from a sine is 90° − x, which is why the subtraction from 90° is needed.

body L15-L22: the B of «Bateni» (L17) prints broken. «Bateni», «Albateni» (L19, L20), «Arzachelis», «az–Zarqālī» and «Casiri» are letter-spaced; «206–207», «az–Zarqālī» and «51,r.–52, r.» have long dashes (5.3, 5.3 and 5.5 pt).
body L23-L28: «Henricus Bates» and «Albategni» (L25) are letter-spaced; «Albategni» (L27) is not. The dots after «accipiendis» (L26) and after «linea.» (L28) are five.

notes_left L1-L6: «Alfonso X de Castilla» is letter-spaced; the dash after «teny.» (L3) measures 5.4 pt, a long dash; «D Manuel» (L5) is printed without a full stop after the D. The dash of «1863-67» is joined to both figures; its free part measures about 3.4 pt, the length of the hyphens of the notes.
notes_left L7-L8: the sign × ending L7 is repeated at the beginning of L8, as printed; the p of «30p» prints broken. R cos 60° = 60p × 30p = 1800, as printed.

notes_left L9-L16: the l of «planeta» (L11) prints only in its upper part, like an apostrophe, and the f of «fincar» (L15) prints broken; the hyphen of «adda-» (L16) prints as a point. The Spanish text has CLXXX, which Nallino marks [sic!], for 1800.

notes_right L1-L16: «Han-» and «rici», divided between L6 and L7, «Bate», «Abraham Iudei» and «Steinschneider» are letter-spaced. The dash of «d2,v.,–d3,r.» (L9) measures 4.3 pt, a long dash; the dash after «1485).» measures 9.0 pt; «Litteratur-Zeitung» and «444-45» have hyphens (2.0 and 3.4 pt). Quinto idus Octobris is 11 October.
